key_idea: Follow the arrows square by square and list every path.
steps: The middle square only has an arrow to the right. From there the mouse must go right.
Along the top: right, right, down, down. Through the middle: right, down, right, down.
Down first: down, right, right, down. Along the left side: down, down, right, right.

choice_feedback.A: There are more. Try the paths through the middle square too.
choice_feedback.B: You missed one. List the paths along the top, the left side and through the middle.
choice_feedback.D: The middle square has no arrow pointing down, so some paths are not allowed.
choice_feedback.E: The middle square has no arrow pointing down. Paths that go down from there are not allowed.
